cases.given: Versioned local JSON includes valid IPv4 src/dst, TCP, omitted source port and concrete destination port
cases.expected: Accept the directed request and treat omitted source port as unconstrained; read only supplied synthetic evidence

cases.given: Input lacks required source IP, uses ICMP, or has numeric port 65536
cases.expected: Explicit error; do not return empty success or silently approximate unsupported input

cases.given: Saved ACL has ordered r1 permit tcp 443 and r2 deny tcp 443 both matching
cases.expected: Preserve every permit and deny matching row occurrence in ACL snapshot order with no first-match or end-to-end verdict

cases.given: Port 443 against inclusive [443,443], nonmatching [444,445]; 192.0.2.4 against /24 and unrelated /24
cases.expected: Only supported enclosing inclusive port ranges and CIDR networks match; unknown mandatory predicate never silently matches

cases.given: One FW includes repeated WEB_IN binding and two distinct applicable placements; another FW has ACL named WEB_IN
cases.expected: One WEB_IN group per distinct FW, all distinct relevant attachments, no repeated row occurrences from duplicated placements

cases.given: Relevant pair fw-b/acl-2 has no available snapshot
cases.expected: Proposed engineering fail-atomic contract; no successful partial report and no invented NO_MATCH

cases.given: One relevant FW has named ACL with a valid complete snapshot containing no matching rules
cases.expected: Report retains FW and named ACL with empty matched rows, not an access verdict

cases.given: Two relevant devices, one ACL per device and multiple relevant placements for one ACL, with matching rows
cases.expected: Versioned output preserves FW→ACL+placements→matched rows, snapshot row order and no global verdict

cases.given: One relevant ACL snapshot contains unsupported mandatory matcher and another ACL is valid; a supplemental time-range is present on valid rules
cases.expected: Fail-atomic with nonzero stderr, no success stdout for unsupported mandatory matcher; display-only extra alone must not cause error

cases.given: Run with synthetic input and local stored snapshots in isolated environment
cases.expected: No network or device activity; result only from supplied evidence

cases.given: A TCP query omits source port and specifies destination 443; stored supported rule restricts source port 40000
cases.expected: Same match as explicit query source_port=any, while destination 443 still filters; missing port is not invalid input

cases.given: A-to-B query with only B-to-A stored ACL rule matching the reverse tuple
cases.expected: No reverse rule reported; a separate query is required for B-to-A

cases.scenario: Supplemental conditions are displayed but not evaluated
cases.given: A five-field matching rule has a saved time-range flag outside the present time
cases.expected: Return matching rule with supplemental time-range as opaque evidence; do not evaluate its current truth or conclude permit/deny

cases.scenario: Identical rows at different snapshot positions
cases.given: One named ACL has identical permit text at saved lines 2 and 5 and is bound to two relevant placements
cases.expected: One ACL group with both placements and two matching rule occurrences in positions 2 and 5

cases.given: FW-A is relevant with zero ACL; FW-B is irrelevant; separately test no relevant FW
cases.expected: FW-A appears with zero ACL children and FW-B is absent; no relevant FW produces an empty FW collection

cases.given: ACL-A and ACL-B snapshots have different successful timestamps, and a later failed update on ACL-A
cases.expected: Report retains distinct original last-success timestamps and original ACL-A data; no invented match failure notification
